slides.title: Breaking the Blocks

content_blocks.block_data: Unit 1 · Foundations of Creativity and Innovation · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.1, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: Forced Connection. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: Every business runs on assumptions nobody has questioned in years. Your job is to find one and turn it upside down.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: The owner cannot see them because they are the water. You can, because you arrived last week.
'Customers want low prices' becomes 'what if they wanted high prices?' — you are not saying the owner is wrong, you are testing whether the rule is load-bearing.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.lead: Most reversals fail, and that is fine
block_data.body: Nine will be nonsense. The tenth reorganises the business.

block_data.lead: The one that scares you is the signal
block_data.body: If a reversal makes you uncomfortable, it is touching something real.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: List ten things your anchor's owner believes must be true. Then turn each one upside down.

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
